lines.en: Squeak, slithering forward.
Roots dig deep, worm moves.
In rolling sand, form unseen.
Thorns fly, moving slowly.
Worms in sand, silent.
Rolling, thorns crunch.
Thorns pierce, moving on.
Worm in sand, spikes like arrows.
Spikes pop, worm undaunted.
Spikes pierce, worm moves on.

lines.zh: 一节节身体拱起，钻进沙丘。
lines.en: My segmented body arches and burrows into the dune.
My spines scrape the sand, leaving grooves.
Silent in sand, roots like needles.
Silent in sand, roots like needles.
Buried in sand, still as stone.
Roots deep, sand still.
Silent in sand, spikes like needles.
Roots in sand, still laid.
Silent in sand, spikes like needles.
Silent in sand, spikes like needles.
Silent in sand, spikes sharp.
Roots in sand, quietly lain.

lines.zh: 把大半截身子埋进沙里。
lines.en: Most of me stays buried in the sand.

lines.zh: 只露一圈尖刺，装作仙人掌。
lines.en: Only a ring of spines shows; I pose as a cactus.

lines.zh: 在干沙里吸水，一动不动。
lines.en: I drink from dry sand without moving.

lines.zh: 我把刺收起来，缩成沙堆。
lines.en: I fold my spines in and shrink into a mound of sand.
Move in sand, watching you.
Spikes like eyes, watching you.
Roots like claws, probing.
Spikes like needles, moving in sand.
Roots in sand, watching you.
Spikes like tongues, probing you.
Roots like hands, probing.
Spikes like knives, probing.
Roots in sand, watching you.
Spikes like needles, moving quietly.

lines.zh: 沙面下，我数着你的脚步。
lines.en: Beneath the sand I count your steps.
You thought that was a cactus?

lines.zh: 沙里冒出一只环形的眼。
lines.en: A ringed eye rises from the sand.

lines.zh: 你的影子压到我身上了。
lines.en: Your shadow just fell across me.
I smell the water in your flask.

lines.zh: 沙粒从我的刺间漏下去。
lines.en: Sand slips between my spines.
You walked too close and stirred the sand.

lines.zh: 我抬头时，你就在三格内。
lines.en: When I surface, you are three blocks off.
My body is softening...
I feel the pain...
My skin is pierced...
My shell is cracking...
I feel weak...
My tentacles are torn...

lines.zh: 刺扎回去，我的汁液是绿的。
lines.en: The spines pierce back; my sap runs green.
I'm starting to feel uncomfortable...
I'm losing strength...
I'm feeling fear...
Stay back, this is my territory!
Feel my spines!
Who dares to invade me?

lines.zh: 你的食物就是我的食物。
lines.en: Your food is my food.
Don't think you can get my fruit.
Taste my venomous spines!

lines.zh: 远离我，否则你会后悔的。
lines.en: Stay away or you'll regret it!
He who eats me, he who regrets.

lines.zh: 我是这片土地的守护者。
lines.en: I'm the guardian of this land.
My spines will make you regret.
Don't touch me, beware my spines!

lines.zh: 我的盾牌挡住了你的攻击。
lines.en: My shield blocked your attack.

lines.zh: 你太过分了，现在尝尝我的反击！
lines.en: You've gone too far, now taste my retaliation!

lines.zh: 你的攻击只会加剧我的愤怒。
lines.en: Your attacks only anger me more.

lines.zh: 盾牌能挡一时，挡不住我的多次攻击。
lines.en: A shield can block for a while, not my multiple attacks.

lines.zh: 我的刺会记住你的位置。
lines.en: My spines will remember your position.
Try moving me, then!

lines.zh: 盾牌挡不住我所有的刺。
lines.en: Your shield can't block all my spines.
Be careful, my spines are deadly.

lines.zh: 我的攻击速度比你想象的快。
lines.en: My attack speed is faster than you think.

lines.zh: 找到合适的伴侣才能繁衍。
lines.en: Find a mate to reproduce.

lines.zh: 寻找一个能繁衍的伴侣。
lines.en: Find a mate for reproduction.

lines.zh: 寻找一个共同生存的伴侣。
lines.en: Find a partner to survive together.
Find a partner for reproduction.

lines.zh: 找到合适的伴侣才能共生。
lines.en: Find a suitable partner for coexistence.
Find a partner for coexistence.

lines.zh: 寻找一个可以繁衍后代的伴侣。
lines.en: Find a partner to produce offspring.
Find a partner for symbiosis.
Find a partner for coexistence.

lines.zh: 找到能够共同繁衍的伴侣。
lines.en: Find a partner for shared reproduction.

lines.zh: 干瘪的身躯挤满仙人掌刺。
lines.en: Dry body packed with cacti spines.

lines.zh: 坚硬的仙人掌刺保护着我。
lines.en: Hard cactus spines protect me.

lines.zh: 这里是仙人掌丛生之地。
lines.en: This is a cactus-infested area.
Spines pierce your flesh.
Find cracks for me to pass.
Shield not strong enough.

lines.zh: 仙人掌刺扎入你的皮肤。
lines.en: Cactus spines pierce your skin.

lines.zh: 我需要更多仙人掌碎片。
lines.en: More cactus shards needed.
Shield can’t defend anymore.
Find my trail here.
I see you.

lines.zh: 沙地上，我已经对准你的脚。
lines.en: On the sand, I've already aimed at your feet.
Prey trembles in the dark.

lines.zh: 靠近我会后悔，我提醒过了。
lines.en: Come closer and you will regret it, I warned you.

lines.zh: 我的刺已经瞄准你的盾。
lines.en: My spines are aimed at your shield.
Cactus needles, one after another.
Nowhere to run.

lines.zh: 我的刺很快就会扎入你。
lines.en: My spines will soon pierce you.

lines.zh: 你离死亡不远了，我的刺一根根飞出去。
lines.en: Death is near; my spines fly one by one.

lines.zh: 我的刺一根根立了起来。
lines.en: My spines stand up one by one.

lines.zh: 沙下震动，我知道你在哪。
lines.en: The sand trembles; I know where you are.
There is blood-smell in that direction.
The prey stepped onto my dune.

lines.zh: 我要从你脚下破沙而出。
lines.en: I will burst from the sand under your feet.
You carry water. I want it.
The sand line bends along your path.

lines.zh: 一身的刺，都是单独的箭。
lines.en: Every spine on me is a separate arrow.
Wait for the right moment.
Spines ready, pierce at any time.
Beware, my spines are sharp.
My attack is everywhere.
Approach me, you’ll be attacked.
My shield protects me.

lines.zh: 攻击我只会浪费你的弹药。
lines.en: Attacking me wastes your ammo.
You can’t defeat me.
My spines will torment you.
Every spine tip turns toward you.
By the time you raise your shield, my spines are out.

lines.zh: 你的盾挡不住这么多根。
lines.en: Your shield cannot hold against this many spines.
Beneath the sand I circle behind you.

lines.zh: 数到第三根，你的盾就裂。
lines.en: By the third spine, your shield gives out.

lines.zh: 你在看仙人掌，我在看你。
lines.en: You watch the cactus; I watch you.

lines.zh: 沙丘顶上，刺都竖起来了。
lines.en: On the dune top, all my spines lift.
One block closer and I fire.
Sssss! It spits out thorns.
Watch out! My thorns!
You’re too close! Feel the thorns!
You don’t want to touch my thorns!
Hey! Don’t touch my thorns!

lines.zh: 我的刺可以扎穿你的皮肤！
lines.en: My thorns can pierce your skin!

lines.zh: 三根刺就够磨光你的盾。
lines.en: Three spines are enough to wear your shield down.
Watch out! These are dangerous!
You touched me! Now taste this!
You’re too close to me!
A whole row of spines fires at once.

lines.zh: 刺钉进盾面，震得你手麻。
lines.en: Spines bite the shield and numb your arm.
I burst from the sand and coil round your ankle.
Your calf is bristling with thin spines.

lines.zh: 这是仙人掌的味道，尝吧。
lines.en: Taste what a cactus can do.
The second volley is already loaded.

lines.zh: 干旱之地的夜晚，我会苏醒。
lines.en: On dry land, I awaken at night.
Night is the best time to hunt.
As dusk falls, I begin to move.
In the darkness, I silently approach.

lines.zh: 每当月光洒落，我便醒来。
lines.en: Whenever moonlight falls, I awaken.
Hidden in the day, emerging at night.
At night, my thorns are more deadly.
Night, the time to stalk.
Wait for a moonless, windy night.

lines.zh: 只有在寂静的夜晚，我才会现身。
lines.en: I only appear on silent nights.
The dune swells; I break through the surface.
In the dry wind, I wake.

lines.zh: 仙人掌丛中多了一根会动的。
lines.en: One cactus in the patch now moves.

lines.zh: 沙子灌满了我刚钻的洞。
lines.en: Sand fills the hole I just left.

lines.zh: 白天的热浪把我从地下催出来。
lines.en: The day's heat drives me up from below.

lines.zh: 我顺着沙纹，慢慢拱出地面。
lines.en: I follow the sand ripples up to the surface.
The sandstorm ended, so I come up for air.
The sand under your feet suddenly loosens.
The flames are spreading...

lines.zh: 摔下去，刺全扎进自己身上。
lines.en: Falling drove my own spines into me.
Drowned in water... I can't breathe...
The explosion made me dizzy...

lines.zh: 盾牌挡不住这么多根刺。
lines.en: A shield can't stop this many spines.
The magic made me shiver...
No food... I starved to death...

lines.zh: 雷劈在仙人掌上，我抖了一下。
lines.en: Lightning hits the cactus and I jerk.
The darkness devoured me...
